description: This file contains low-level system initialization and reset functions for the ESP32 SoC within the Zephyr RTOS environment, including startup routines, CPU reset, and hardware configuration.

methods.name: esp_start_appcpu
methods.description: Starts the application CPU by loading firmware segments into IRAM and DRAM, then jumping to the entry point.

methods.name: __esp_platform_start
methods.description: Main startup function called during system boot, performs hardware initialization, cache setup, and starts Zephyr.

methods.name: arch_printk_char_out
methods.description: Outputs a character to UART, adding carriage return before newline.

methods.name: sys_arch_reboot
methods.description: Triggers system reboot by calling esp_restart_noos.

methods.name: esp_restart_noos
methods.description: Performs a system reset by disabling interrupts, resetting cores, and reinitializing hardware components.
